scope: Prospective controls of the frozen Row_Calib_1 derived family, a compensated 40x40 picture, and the Row_Calib_1 target repainted with compensation; research only

compensation.verticalRule: draw row r only over columns where target(r) AND target(r+1): a stroke paints texel rows r and r+1
compensation.basis: Row_Calib_1 picture: start paint edge at -1.93..-2.06 texel of the first column (24/24 runs); end edge -0.3..-0.45 (X~934) and -1.4..-1.64 (X~1007) texel of the last boundary; end shift 1 is a midpoint, location dependence unresolved; bottom edge observed 1 row below the target

rules.controls: 19 body sections; same label rule as calib1; accepted label must equal the planned row -> CONFIRMED; accepted but different -> DERIVED_CONTRADICTED; otherwise INCOMPLETE
rules.interior: every interior target texel centre (all 8 neighbours target) is strong paint (gray drop>80) vs blank stage-before
rules.holes: every hole texel centre at Chebyshev distance>=3 from target paint has no RGB>12 change
rules.edges: edge position by (bg+inside)/2 from a point inside paint (V: one column inside the figure); an edge is measured when >=80% of its samples are; residual H: g(edge)-(boundary+topPhase|bottomPhase), V: column phase(edge)-boundary; 0 D-events per edge (detector over consecutive measured samples)
rules.status: descriptive picture verdicts; never change the control verdict
